label: Scheduled SLA and auto-close events service
instruction: Generate a concise modules/complaint_cms/services/events.py module (maximum 60 lines) with process_complaint_sla() and auto_close_resolved_complaints() functions using existing Complaint, ComplaintTask, ComplaintUpdate, and ComplaintNotification models. process_complaint_sla() finds overdue active complaints (sla_due_at < timezone.now()), increments escalation_level, sets status to escalated, and records an update/notification. auto_close_resolved_complaints() finds resolved complaints older than 7 days and closes them. No Celery decorators in services. Return raw Python source only without code fences.
